aiOverview.content: Lauren Betts (born 2003) is a 6'7" UCLA basketball standout who has publicly shared her journey overcoming childhood bullying regarding her height and a 2024 hospitalization for depression. She is highly focused on her mental health and basketball career, keeping her personal life private, and is particularly close to her mother, Michelle. Key Details About Her Personal Life: Family Background: Born to parents Andy and Michelle Betts, who met as athletes at Long Beach State and later divorced. Her father was a professional basketball player who played in Europe and was drafted by the NBA's Charlotte Hornets. Sibling Connection: She has three siblings: Sienna, Dylan, and Ashton. Her sister, Sienna, is also a basketball player at UCLA. Mental Health Advocacy: Following a 2024 hospitalization, she has been vocal about her journey with depression and therapy, aiming to destigmatize mental health discussions for athletes. Career and Education: After a freshman year at Stanford, she transferred to UCLA, aiming to bring the school a national championship. Hobbies/Personal Interests: She has mentioned enjoying fashion and, in 2025, appeared on RuPaul's Drag Race All Stars for a makeover challenge. Betts has built a "safe space" with her mother, who was instrumental in her recovery from depression. She is currently viewed as an active proponent of mental health awareness.
